```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

### Load Data
```{r}
# Load data in
songs <- read.csv("song_longevity.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

# Initial look of data
str(songs)
summary(songs)
```
### Clean Data
```{r}
# Remove unnecessary columns
songs$track_id <- NULL
songs$streams_3yr <- NULL
```
*explanation*

### Exploratory Data Analysis

### Convert factors into dummy variables
```{r}
# store is_hit as a factor of 0 and 1 levels
songs$is_hit <- factor(songs$is_hit, levels = c(0, 1))
d_without_is_hit <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(is_hit ~ ., data = songs)[, -1])
dummies <- data.frame(d_without_is_hit, hit = songs$is_hit)
```

### Split 50/50 train and test data
```{r}
ratio = 0.5
set.seed(12345)

train_rows <- sample(1:nrow(dummies), ratio*nrow(dummies))
song_train <- dummies[train_rows, ]
song_test <- dummies[-train_rows, ]

mean(as.numeric(song_train$is_hit))
mean(as.numeric(song_test$is_hit))
```

### Min-max normalize train and test data
```{r}
# Distance and gradient based models (KNN, ANN, SVM, K-means) need every
# predictor on the same scale, so min-max normalize each predictor to 0-1.
# The min and max come from the training data only and are then applied to
# the test data, so nothing about the test set leaks into the scaling.
# (Test values outside the training range can land slightly below 0 or above 1.)
# The outcome, hit, is left as a factor.
predictors <- setdiff(names(song_train), "hit")

train_min <- sapply(song_train[, predictors], min)
train_max <- sapply(song_train[, predictors], max)

normalize <- function(df) {
  scaled <- as.data.frame(Map(function(x, lo, hi) (x - lo) / (hi - lo),
                              df[, predictors], train_min, train_max))
  rownames(scaled) <- rownames(df)
  scaled$hit <- df$hit
  scaled
}

song_train_norm <- normalize(song_train)
song_test_norm <- normalize(song_test)

summary(song_train_norm)
```

### Load into RDS
```{r}
saveRDS(song_train, "rds/song_train.rds")
saveRDS(song_test, "rds/song_test.rds")

# normalized versions
saveRDS(song_train_norm, "rds/song_train_norm.rds")
saveRDS(song_test_norm, "rds/song_test_norm.rds")
```
